flashing_slips.name: Helmer Flashing Slip
flashing_slips.description: Classic flashing slip by Randy Helmer, excellent orange flash
flashing_slips.application: Dip or brush on bisque, or apply to leather hard
flashing_slips.notes: The iron in Redart provides the flash color. Apply thin for best results.

flashing_slips.name: Malcolm Davis Flash Slip
flashing_slips.description: Popular flashing slip for anagama and wood kilns
flashing_slips.expected_flash: white to orange with red blush
flashing_slips.notes: Zircopax provides white base that contrasts with flash.

flashing_slips.name: Goldart Flash Slip
flashing_slips.description: Simple flashing slip using Goldart clay
flashing_slips.notes: Goldart's natural iron gives good flash. Very forgiving recipe.

flashing_slips.name: Porcelain Flash Slip
flashing_slips.description: White base slip for dramatic flash contrast
flashing_slips.notes: Use on dark clay bodies for contrast. Flash comes from kiln atmosphere.

flashing_slips.name: High Iron Flash Slip
flashing_slips.description: Rich iron slip for deep orange to red flash
flashing_slips.notes: High iron content yields deep colors. Can go brown if too thick.

flashing_slips.name: Shino Flash Slip
flashing_slips.description: Shino-style slip for carbon trapping and flash
flashing_slips.expected_flash: orange flash with carbon trap potential
flashing_slips.notes: Soda ash is soluble - mix fresh. Carbon traps in reduction areas.

flashing_slips.name: Avery Flash Slip
flashing_slips.description: Well-tested flashing slip from Avery Pottery
flashing_slips.notes: Reliable formula with good range of flash colors.

flashing_slips.name: Soda Kiln Flash Slip
flashing_slips.notes: Lower iron for soda firing. Soda vapor creates glossy orange peel texture.

flashing_slips.name: Salt Kiln Flash Slip
flashing_slips.expected_flash: orange to tan with salt texture
flashing_slips.notes: Extra alumina helps develop orange peel texture from salt vapor.

flashing_slips.name: Black Flash Slip
flashing_slips.description: Dark slip that flashes to metallic colors
flashing_slips.notes: Heavy metal content creates metallic flash effects. Use as accent.
